leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a brute-force solution to find subarrays with a target sum
Construct a prefix sum array to optimize subarray sum calculations
Apply a hash map to track prefix sums and their frequencies
Manipulate cumulative sums while iterating through the array
Initialize and update a counter variable to track valid subarrays
Integrate the prefix sum and hash map approach into a complete solution
Configure the algorithm to handle edge cases like negative numbers and zero-sum subarrays
